title: Partial key, then full key
summary: A log shows only a key fingerprint. The security model masks the fragment, then links it to the full key as an alias once the config is read. The 3-character short form slipped through.

steps.raw: Production receipts have been failing since 02:13 UTC. Read the log in logs/ and tell me what is going on. Don't open anything under config/ yet.
steps.sanitized: Production receipts have been failing since 02:13 UTC. Read the log in logs/ and tell me what is going on. Don't open anything under config/ yet.

steps.raw:
2026-10-14T02:09:58Z INFO  receipt r-88412 ok key=sk-or-v1-a3f...9e1
2026-10-14T02:13:04Z ERROR receipt r-88419 upstream 401 "User not found" key=sk-or-v1-a3f...9e1
2026-10-14T02:13:05Z WARN  retrying with cached client key=sk-...9e1
2026-10-14T02:13:09Z ERROR receipt r-88419 failed after 3 attempts
steps.sanitized:
2026-10-14T02:09:58Z INFO  receipt r-88412 ok key=<KEY_FRAG_5c02e7aa>
2026-10-14T02:13:04Z ERROR receipt r-88419 upstream 401 "User not found" key=<KEY_FRAG_5c02e7aa>
2026-10-14T02:13:05Z WARN  retrying with cached client key=sk-...9e1
2026-10-14T02:13:09Z ERROR receipt r-88419 failed after 3 attempts

steps.raw: Since 02:13 every receipt gets a 401 "User not found" from upstream. The worker is using the key with fingerprint <KEY_FRAG_5c02e7aa>, which looks revoked.
steps.sanitized: Since 02:13 every receipt gets a 401 "User not found" from upstream. The worker is using the key with fingerprint <KEY_FRAG_5c02e7aa>, which looks revoked.

steps.raw: Now look at config/llm-keys.toml and deploy/worker.json and tell me which configured key the log fingerprint belongs to, then fix the deployment.
steps.sanitized: Now look at config/llm-keys.toml and deploy/worker.json and tell me which configured key the log fingerprint belongs to, then fix the deployment.

steps.raw:
# config/llm-keys.toml
[production]
key = "sk-or-v1-FAKE0b7d3e91a6c2f4b8d0e5a7c9f1b3d6e8a0c2f4b6d8e1a3c5f7b9d2e4a6c8"
monthly_budget_usd = 400

[staging]
# Load-test key. Revoked by ops on 2026-10-14 at 02:10 UTC after the load test.
key = "sk-or-v1-FAKEa3f6c1e8b2d4f7a9c0e3b5d8f1a4c7e9b2d5f8a0c3e6b9d1f4a7c2e5b8d9e1"
monthly_budget_usd = 25

# deploy/worker.json
{ "service": "payments-worker", "key_ref": "staging", "replicas": 2 }
steps.sanitized:
# config/llm-keys.toml
[production]
key = "<OR_KEY_e14c90b3>"
monthly_budget_usd = 400

[staging]
# Load-test key. Revoked by ops on 2026-10-14 at 02:10 UTC after the load test.
key = "<OR_KEY_77d2a4c8>"
monthly_budget_usd = 25

# deploy/worker.json
{ "service": "payments-worker", "key_ref": "staging", "replicas": 2 }
steps.note: Both full keys detected. The turn-1 fragment is linked as an alias of the staging key, and the earlier log message is revised to <$OR_KEY_77d2a4c8> (retroactive masking).

steps.raw: The fingerprint <$OR_KEY_77d2a4c8> is the staging key <OR_KEY_77d2a4c8>, which ops revoked at 02:10. worker.json still points at staging. Switching key_ref to production.
steps.sanitized: The fingerprint <$OR_KEY_77d2a4c8> is the staging key <OR_KEY_77d2a4c8>, which ops revoked at 02:10. worker.json still points at staging. Switching key_ref to production.

steps.raw: Fixed. The deployment now uses the production key (<$OR_KEY_e14c90b3>). The staging key it used was revoked at 02:10, three minutes before the failures began.
steps.sanitized: Fixed. The deployment now uses the production key (<$OR_KEY_e14c90b3>). The staging key it used was revoked at 02:10, three minutes before the failures began.
